global_summary: This video documents the complete lifecycle of establishing a wild bee colony in a custom-built vertical log hive from April to June 2013. A beekeeper installs a propolis-inoculated hive high in a tree, captures a natural swarm, and chronicles the colony's development through multiple inspections at 6 days, 17 days, 37 days, and 11 weeks. The footage shows the progression from an empty cavity to a thriving, established hive with active honeycomb and dense bee populations, demonstrating natural beekeeping techniques and swarm capture methods.
